in_hebrew.name: Aurthur
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Golden rule, noble one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Aurthur הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘eoworth’, meaning ‘wealthy, noble, or worthy’. The name symbolizes adherence to the golden rule and carrying oneself with dignity.

in_greek.name: Aurthur
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Golden rule, noble one
in_greek.long_meaning: Aurthur είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English ‘eoworth’, meaning ‘wealthy, noble, or worthy’. The name symbolizes adherence to the golden rule and carrying oneself with dignity.

in_latin.name: Aurthur
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Golden rule, noble one
in_latin.long_meaning: Aurthur est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English ‘eoworth’, meaning ‘wealthy, noble, or worthy’. The name symbolizes adherence to the golden rule and carrying oneself with dignity.
